The T2-FLAIR mismatch sign is a specific imaging biomarker for IDH-mutant, 1p/19q non-codeleted astrocytomas. The tumor is also largely non-enhancing (0.4% enhancing volume), which is more typical for IDH-mutant tumors. While features like a large necrotic core (64.26%) and significant mass effect are often seen in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma, the specificity of the T2-FLAIR mismatch sign in a younger patient strongly outweighs these findings.
